prompt: Rockfinger: A gnarled, wind-stripped hardwood rooted in the rim cracks of the tall stone, branches clawing out over the drop, bark pale as the stone it grips. The tree retains its realistic pale wind-stripped hardwood form while displaying a clearly alien foliage structure and distinctive branch growth visible at normal play scale.
